allow_express_checkout.help: This controls whether customers can use express payment methods. Express checkout enables customers to pay with Google Pay and Apple Pay from which address information is collected at payment.

allow_tokenization.help: This controls whether customers can save their payment methods as payment tokens. A payment token is an anonymous link to the payment method details saved in the provider's database, allowing the customer to reuse it for a next purchase.

auth_msg.help: The message displayed if payment is authorized

available_country_ids.help: The countries in which this payment provider is available. Leave blank to make it available in all countries.

available_currency_ids.help: The currencies available with this payment provider. Leave empty not to restrict any.

available_pricelist_ids.help: Only allow this payment provider when the partner's pricelist matches one of these.

cancel_msg.help: The message displayed if the order is cancelled during the payment process

capture_manually.help: Capture the amount from Odoo, when the delivery is completed. Use this if you want to charge your customers cards only when you are sure you can ship the goods to them.

code.help: The technical code of this payment provider.

done_msg.help: The message displayed if the order is successfully done after the payment process

express_checkout_form_view_id.help: The template rendering the express payment methods' form.

inline_form_view_id.help: The template rendering the inline payment form when making a direct payment

is_live.help: If live mode is disabled, a fake payment is processed through a test payment interface. This mode is advised when setting up the provider.

is_published.help: Whether the provider is visible on the website or not. Tokens remain functional but are only visible on manage forms.

journal_id.help: The journal in which the successful transactions are posted.

main_currency_id.help: The main currency of the company, used to display monetary fields.

maximum_amount.help: The maximum payment amount that this payment provider is available for. Leave blank to make it available for any payment amount.

minimum_amount.help: The minimum payment amount that this payment provider is available for. Leave blank to make it available for any payment amount.

pending_msg.help: The message displayed if the order pending after the payment process

pre_msg.help: The message displayed to explain and help the payment process

redirect_form_view_id.help: The template rendering a form submitted to redirect the user when making a payment

so_reference_type.help: You can set here the communication type that will appear on sales orders.The communication will be given to the customer when they choose the payment method.

support_refund.help: Refund is a feature allowing to refund customers directly from the payment in Odoo.

token_inline_form_view_id.help: The template rendering the inline payment form when making a payment by token.

payment.provider.order: module_state desc, is_published desc, sequence, name

demo_simulated_state.help: The state in which transactions created from this token should be set.

payment_details.help: The clear part of the payment method's payment details.

payment_method_code.help: The technical code of this payment method.

provider_code.help: The technical code of this payment provider.

provider_ref.help: The provider reference of the token of the transaction.

capture_manually.help: Capture the amount from Odoo, when the delivery is completed. Use this if you want to charge your customers cards only when you are sure you can ship the goods to them.

child_transaction_ids.help: The child transactions of the transaction.

is_live.help: Whether the transaction happened in a production environment. False for transactions created before this tracking was implemented.

landing_route.help: The route the user is redirected to after the transaction

payment_method_code.help: The technical code of this payment method.

provider_code.help: The technical code of this payment provider.

provider_reference.help: The provider reference of the transaction

reference.help: The internal reference of the transaction

source_transaction_id.help: The source transaction of the related child transactions

state_message.help: The complementary information message about the state

tokenize.help: Whether a payment token should be created when post-processing the transaction
